mire_blob.name: mire blob
mire_blob.description: A quivering, knee-high blob of grey-green jelly that smells of the ditch.

crimson_blob.name: crimson blob
crimson_blob.description: A blob the colour of a fresh bruise, rather sharper tempered than its grey cousins.

gloomwing.name: gloomwing
gloomwing.description: A small leathery thing, half bat and half lizard, that flaps out of the dusk at your face.

pale_shade.name: pale shade
pale_shade.description: A smear of cold white that drifts a hand's breadth above the grass.

hedge_mage.name: hedge mage
hedge_mage.description: A ragged hedge-wizard with a bundle of crooked twigs and a worse temper.

hexwing.name: hexwing
hexwing.description: A gloomwing grown clever, with a smear of arcane chalk on its brow.

dune_stinger.name: dune stinger
dune_stinger.description: A scorpion the length of a forearm, the colour of dry grass.

bog_imp.name: bog imp
bog_imp.description: A squat, mud-streaked imp with a grin full of reeds.

rattling_spirit.name: rattling spirit
rattling_spirit.description: A knot of cold air that clatters the stones around it like dice in a cup.

fen_brute.name: fen brute
fen_brute.description: A heavy, hunched thing out of the marsh with arms too long for it.

fellwing.name: fellwing
fellwing.description: A big black gloomwing that mends itself between bites.

bone_walker.name: bone walker
bone_walker.description: A walking skeleton in the rags of whoever it used to be, with a notched blade.

hexer.name: hexer
hexer.description: A hooded, hollow-eyed caster who is always muttering.

iron_stinger.name: iron stinger
iron_stinger.description: A scorpion with a shell like riveted plate, and a surprising turn of speed.

grey_wolf.name: grey wolf
grey_wolf.description: A lean grey wolf with a ruff of scars.

gaunt_wraith.name: gaunt wraith
gaunt_wraith.description: A tall, tattered shape of dark air with two points of cold light where the eyes would be.

quicksilver_blob.name: quicksilver blob
quicksilver_blob.description: A small, bright blob of mercury-grey that turns and runs the moment it sees you.

barrow_haunt.name: barrow haunt
barrow_haunt.description: A pale figure that rises out of the earth with a grave-cloth about it.

packlord.name: packlord
packlord.description: A great black wolf that stands a hand taller than the rest and does not blink.

bog_chieftain.name: bog chieftain
bog_chieftain.description: An imp grown to a man's height, wearing a necklace of finger bones.

fen_sage.name: fen sage
fen_sage.description: A brute with a sage's staff and a sage's sneer.

crag_wyvern.name: crag wyvern
crag_wyvern.description: A grey, long-necked wyvern with a barbed tail and nothing like a sense of humour.

pale_stinger.name: pale stinger
pale_stinger.description: A bone-white scorpion as large as a hound.

hollow_knight.name: hollow knight
hollow_knight.description: An empty suit of black armour, with something in it that heals.

mossback_colossus.name: mossback colossus
mossback_colossus.description: A man-shaped heap of mossy stone, taller than a door, that has stood there longer than the road.

gilded_husk.name: gilded husk
gilded_husk.description: A statue of a man in beaten gold that has no business walking.

sable_knight.name: sable knight
sable_knight.description: A knight in black plate and a black plume who does not talk.

hexwyvern.name: hexwyvern
hexwyvern.description: A wyvern with runes scratched into its scales, and a drowsy, murmuring gaze.

dread_knight.name: dread knight
dread_knight.description: A towering knight in horned plate, and nothing, you suspect, behind the visor.

moonhowler.name: moonhowler
moonhowler.description: A wolf that walks on two legs and wears the ragged remains of a man's coat.

verdant_drake.name: verdant drake
verdant_drake.description: A thick-bodied green drake with a throat that glows when it breathes in.

skylord_wyvern.name: skylord wyvern
skylord_wyvern.description: A great winged wyvern with a gold crest, mending itself as it circles.

archmage.name: archmage
archmage.description: A gaunt mage in star-patterned robes whose spells hurt a good deal.

cleaver_knight.name: cleaver knight
cleaver_knight.description: A knight with a broad, double-bladed axe and a habit of putting people to sleep first.

azure_drake.name: azure drake
azure_drake.description: A blue drake with frost on its scales and fire in its throat.

granite_giant.name: granite giant
granite_giant.description: A giant of grey stone as big as a cart, slow and very hard to hurt.

bastion_knight.name: bastion knight
bastion_knight.description: A knight in towering plate, behind a shield taller than he is.

crimson_drake.name: crimson drake
crimson_drake.description: A red drake of the old kind, the size of a barn door, with a mouth like a forge.

maldrath_man.name: Maldrath, the Drake Sovereign
maldrath_man.description: A tall man in black robes and a crown of iron thorns, with the cold patience of a long winter. The Dawnglass burns in the air behind his shoulder.

maldrath_wyrm.name: Maldrath, the Drake Sovereign (wyrm)
maldrath_wyrm.description: The man is gone. What fills the hall is a drake the size of a barn, black as a burnt tree, wearing the crown of iron thorns.

verdant_drake_warden.name: verdant drake
verdant_drake_warden.description: A thick-bodied green drake coiled across the cell door, with a throat that glows each time it breathes in. It has been guarding the princess a long time, and has the look of an animal that has enjoyed it.
